qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Regulated utility monopoly across Michigan's Lower Peninsula. High legal and capital barriers eliminate competition. Cost-of-service tariffs pass through commodity and capital costs with authorized ROEs around 9.9%, capping ROIC at ~5.6%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet & Cash Conversion, REJECT). Regulated electric and gas monopoly serving Michigan with clean execution on coal phase-out and regulatory rate base growth. However, structural leverage ($17.8B long-term debt, 16.6x net income, interest coverage 2.2x) and massive ongoing capex ($24B+ 5Y plan) require perpetual capital market access and equity dilution, while ROIC is capped at ~5.6%.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median ROIC of 5.6%. FY2025 long-term debt of $17,807M dwarfs net income of $1,071M (16.6x ratio). EBIT of $1,727M against interest expense of $789M yields interest coverage of 2.19x, well below the 5.0x requirement. Heavy reliance on first mortgage bonds and equity offerings ($500M-$700M/year) to fund multi-billion annual capex.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
